method_note: Moneycontrol-only strict collector. Google News RSS is used for discovery only. Every article must have a publication date verified from the original Moneycontrol page and be within the rolling last 10 days. Confirmed items require a labelled stock section and explicitly labelled entry, target and stop-loss. Unverified trade-related candidates are stored separately in watchlist_items. Generic stock mentions, undated pages, old pages and future-dated pages are excluded. Missing values are never invented. This is automated extraction, not investment advice.
